prompt: Use case: historical literary character portrait. Create one distinct original illustration of Cedric the Saxon as first introduced in chapter III of Walter Scott's Ivanhoe. Long yellow-blond hair neatly parted in the centre and falling to his shoulders, barely touched by grey. Waist-up seated portrait beside a carved dark-oak chair in a low Saxon timber hall: smoky dark rafters, warm hearth light, restrained red woven hanging in soft focus. Suggest a short broad-headed boar spear leaning behind his chair without turning it into a royal sceptre. Detailed mature painterly historical book plate, natural individual face, dignified humanity, muted green, warm grey, ochre and scarlet, fine oil-and-watercolour texture, strong legibility at portrait-card size. No crown, heraldic lion, throne room, Norman stone keep, fantasy plate armour, modern clothes, film actor resemblance, written name, letters, labels, logos or watermark. Do not depict later adventures, family reunions, other characters or narrative spoilers. Single portrait, vertical composition.
